payload.claim: The sentence "They pass `ABORTED` at one, its abort path (`saffron/cell/session.py:4150`)" is false at this snapshot (base `a9c0a91e`). Line 4150 is `ledger.set_run_preflight(run_id, "FAILED")` inside the `except preflight.PreflightFailed` branch, which itself writes `COMPLETE`. The actual `ledger.finish_run(run_id, "ABORTED")` call sits at line 4163. The citation was correct at `f605529d` (the commit the spec says its lines were read at); `session.py` picked up unrelated changes between `f605529d` and `a9c0a91e` that shifted roughly 13 lines before this point, and the citation was never refreshed. The same stale `:4150` citation also appears in backlog item `b-60f950`. This has no effect on scope or build: `saffron/cell/session.py` is in `forbidden` and untouched by any criterion, and the "Out of scope" claim it supports (every `finish_run` caller already passes a set member) remains independently true — all 10 `finish_run` call sites in `session.py` (9x COMPLETE, 1x ABORTED) and the 1 in `replay.py` (COMPLETE) do pass only set members.
